summary: Frontend-only smoke test after SEO index.html changes. All 8 acceptance criteria pass: robots.txt/sitemap.xml/llms.txt are served with correct Content-Type from the frontend static path; html lang='pt'; meta robots='noindex, nofollow'; OG/canonical/description present; the display:none SEO fallback div inside #root is properly hidden (not visible to user and no flash); React mounts cleanly and replaces the SEO div; login with admin@pdpv.pt/HCNMEnKMLq succeeds (200 POST /api/auth/login → /dashboard); /finance renders with finance-freshness-badge ('Atualizado há 10h'); /tickets loads (100 tickets listed); no React/JS console errors. Only pre-existing WebSocket warnings observed (unrelated to SEO changes).
action_items: OPTIONAL / INFRA (not a code bug): The preview URL serves /robots.txt with a Cloudflare-managed prefix block containing 'User-agent: *  Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference  Allow: /' BEFORE our 'User-agent: *  Disallow: /' entry. Our directives ARE included at the end of the response (verified), and the Sitemap: directive is present. Behaviour on the production domain (tickets.pneusdpedrov.com) may differ if Cloudflare's Managed Robots feature is disabled there. Worth verifying in production; not blocking for this iteration.
OPTIONAL: /clientes route redirected to /dashboard (React Router fallback). Unrelated to SEO changes but worth confirming if this route was expected to be a top-level page.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html changes look clean and side-effect free. The <div style="display:none" aria-hidden="true"> inside #root gets fully replaced by React on mount (childrenCount goes from 1 to 2 with React content), so no orphan SEO nodes remain in the DOM after hydration.
The 4 <noscript> paragraphs (~1237 chars) are correctly placed and only rendered when JS is disabled — verified not visible in a JS-enabled browser (Chrome computed-style walker).
meta robots='noindex, nofollow' + canonical + OG tags all rendered as static <head> nodes, so they are visible to crawlers without JS execution. Good.

robots.txt served at correct Content-Type text/plain; sitemap.xml served as application/xml; llms.txt served as text/plain (1249 bytes = file content). SPA index.html is NOT served for these paths — confirmed.
test_credentials: admin@pdpv.pt / HCNMEnKMLq (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — worked, 200 response, JWT issued, /dashboard accessible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_26 validated frontend after SEO index.html enhancements (lang=pt, meta robots noindex/nofollow, OG/canonical, expanded noscript, hidden SEO fallback in #root). No regressions. Static files /robots.txt /sitemap.xml /llms.txt reachable via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Backend not tested in this iteration (iteration_25 covered Finance smoke 19/19). If further SEO changes are made, re-check that #root inner content still gets swapped by React (no flash) and that meta tags remain in <head>.
rca of the issue: No bug found — validation confirms E1's SEO changes have zero functional regression.
